THE ART OF DISCOVERING POLANDMeet your guide ↓
A PERSON BEHIND THE JOURNEY
TOMASZ KUJAWSKI / YOUR GUIDE

Hi, I'm Tomasz.
Let’s make Poland personal.

For me, a city is more than its landmarks. It is the question you ask at a shipyard gate. A family memory brought back by an old street. A detail on a building that suddenly makes the past feel close.

I guide visitors in English and German, from Gdańsk and the Baltic coast to journeys across Poland. My tours bring together history, local stories and the things you are curious about — whether you arrive with your family, on a cruise, or following your roots.

World War II, Solidarity, life under communism: I like to tell these stories where they happened. And I always leave room for your questions.

FOR CURIOUS MINDS OF EVERY AGE

What if sightseeing
felt like an adventure?

Count the lions of Gdańsk. Look for stories hidden on the façades. Work out how a medieval crane lifted its cargo without electricity.

On family walks, I use questions, clues and playful connections to bring history to life. The aim is to give children something to think about — and stories to tell on the way home.

MY KIND OF TRAVEL

A walk. A conversation.
A different way in.

The view is the beginning. The conversation is what makes it yours.

A shipyard gate can open a conversation about freedom. An old street can lead us to a family story. And a question from a child can take the whole walk in a wonderful new direction.

That is what I want to make room for when we explore together: the history, of course, but also your curiosity. Tell me what you know about Poland, what surprised you, and what you have always wanted to ask.

Coming to Poland for the first time?
Start with a hello. We can find your way in together.Tomasz Kujawski

BEFORE WE GO

Good to know.

Are the tours available in English?

Yes. I guide in English and German. Let me know your preferred language when you get in touch.

Can you plan a tour for my family?

Tell me the children's ages, your group size and what interests them. That helps me suggest a suitable pace and ways to keep everyone involved.

I'm visiting on a cruise. Where do we start?

Include your ship, port, date and arrival and departure times in your enquiry. We'll discuss a route and meeting arrangements around your time ashore.

Can we explore beyond Gdańsk?

Yes. You can ask about Sopot, Malbork, Toruń, Warsaw or a custom journey across Poland. We will confirm the itinerary, arrangements and price together.

How do I enquire?

The form prepares a message in your email app. Review it and send it to oczymmarzysz@icloud.com. This is an enquiry; no reservation or payment is made.
